package domain

const (
	PositionNameFrontend  = "frontend"
	PositionNameBackend   = "backend"
	PositionNameFullstach = "fullstach"
)

// Position describes a learning position with linked technologies and courses.
type Position struct {
	ID        int
	Name      string
	TechIDs   []int
	CourseIDs []string
	Techs     []Tech
	Courses   []CoursePreview
}

// IsValidPositionName reports whether the name is part of the reference dictionary.
func IsValidPositionName(name string) bool {
	switch name {
	case PositionNameFrontend, PositionNameBackend, PositionNameFullstach:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
